name: BasicDiodeModels
_comment_en: Diode small-signal template - Basic level (Analog Insydes BasicDiodeSmallSignal, simp==2). About the operating point the diode is the small-signal conductance g_d = dID/dVD, i.e. the resistance R_eq (REQ) in parallel with the barrier + diffusion capacitance C_d (CAP). Series ohmic RS neglected. Value resolution in netlist/Model.py._diode_ac_param_values: REQ and CAP come straight from the .out OPERATING POINT block.
